tools.name: search_invoices
tools.description: Search invoices by customer, status, or issue-date range and return a paginated list of matches. To fetch one invoice whose id you already know, use get_invoice instead, which is cheaper.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single invoice by its id, including line items and payment history. Use this when you already hold an invoice id. To discover ids from filter criteria, search with search_invoices first.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Creates a new invoice for a customer and returns its id. Writes a billing record that will be visible to the customer once finalized. Use this to bill for a completed order. The invoice opens in draft state so you can review it before sending.

customer_id.description: Customer to bill, UUID v4 format.

amount_cents.description: Total to charge, in USD cents.

tools.name: void_invoice
tools.description: Voids an existing invoice so it can no longer be paid, leaving an audit trail. Use this to cancel a charge that was issued in error. Unlike delete operations, voiding preserves the record for accounting. The invoice must be in draft or open state.

invoice_id.description: Invoice to void, UUID v4 format.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason recorded on the audit trail.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the account, newest first, with optional name-prefix filtering.

name_prefix.description: Case-insensitive prefix to match against the customer display name.

tools.name: update_customer_email
tools.description: Updates the billing email address on a customer record and sends a confirmation message to the new address. The change takes effect immediately for future invoices.

customer_id.description: Customer to modify, UUID v4 format.

email.description: New billing email address, RFC 5322 format.
